name: Stylist
tagline: Send one photo, get an honest style read plus outfits that suit your colouring
description: One full-length photo of you on its own gets a frank assessment rather than flattery, then virtual try-ons in the colours that suit you. Haircut ideas, a look for a big event, and a buy-list with verified prices round it out.
author: prorookiegamer
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
